Lombard Odier Asset Management Switzerland Sa Decreased Stake in Allstate (ALL) as Market Value Declined; Ironsides Asset Advisors Maintains Stake in Vodafone Group Plc New (VOD)
June 6, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Ironsides Asset Advisors Llc increased its stake in Vodafone Group Plc New (VOD) by 215.41% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ironsides Asset Advisors Llc bought 24,725 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.20% with the market. The institutional investor held 36,203 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.01 million, up from 11,478 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ironsides Asset Advisors Llc who had been investing in Vodafone Group Plc New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $70.58B market cap company. The stock increased 0.93% or $0.25 during the last trading session, reaching $26.49. About 114,569 shares traded. Vodafone Group Plc (NASDAQ:VOD) has declined 12.54% since June 6, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 25.11% the S&P500. Lombard Odier Asset Management Switzerland Sa decreased its stake in Allstate Corp (ALL) by 45.35% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Lombard Odier Asset Management Switzerland Sa sold 15,858 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.31% with the market. The institutional investor held 19,107 shares of the property-casualty insurers company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.81 million, down from 34,965 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lombard Odier Asset Management Switzerland Sa who had been investing in Allstate Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $33.10B market cap company. The stock increased 0.50% or $0.47 during the last trading session, reaching $94.17. About 18,951 shares traded. The Allstate Corporation (NYSE:ALL) has risen 10.63% since June 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 1.94% the S&P500.
